thrusters.title: Autopilot Mode
thrusters.tooltip: Game default uses the original autopilot. Fast and Fastest fire several thrusters at once for more speed and plan safer routes.

autoOrient.title: Auto-Align
autoOrient.tooltip: Turns the ship during autopilot so it can thrust at full power. Steering yourself pauses it for a moment.

departureView.title: Keep Destination In View When Leaving
departureView.tooltip: While speeding up, keeps the destination ahead of you in the window.

arrivalView.title: Keep Destination In View When Braking
arrivalView.tooltip: While slowing down, keeps the destination ahead of you instead of behind you.

faceTargetOnArrival.title: Face Destination On Arrival
faceTargetOnArrival.tooltip: When the autopilot finishes, turns the ship to face where you arrived.

avoidObstacles.title: Avoid Planets And Sun
avoidObstacles.tooltip: Plans routes around planets, moons and the Sun instead of flying straight through them.

boostMatchVelocity.title: Faster Match Velocity
boostMatchVelocity.tooltip: Match Velocity also uses the extra thrust.

maxSpeed.title: Speed Limit (0 = none)
maxSpeed.tooltip: Top speed for autopilot flights, in metres per second.

brakingMargin.title: Braking Strength
brakingMargin.tooltip: Lower values start braking earlier and arrive more gently.

cycleThrustersKey.title: Autopilot Mode Key
cycleThrustersKey.tooltip: Switches between autopilot modes while in the cockpit. Examples: J, F6, Numpad1.

alignKey.title: Auto-Align Key
alignKey.tooltip: Turns auto-align on or off during autopilot. Examples: G, F6, Numpad1.

cycleThrustersButton.title: Autopilot Mode Button (Controller)
cycleThrustersButton.tooltip: Switches between autopilot modes while in the cockpit. Options: DpadLeft, DpadRight, DpadUp, DpadDown, North, South, East, West, LeftShoulder, RightShoulder, LeftStick, RightStick, Select, Start, None.

alignButton.title: Auto-Align Button (Controller)
alignButton.tooltip: Turns auto-align on or off during autopilot. Options: DpadLeft, DpadRight, DpadUp, DpadDown, North, South, East, West, LeftShoulder, RightShoulder, LeftStick, RightStick, Select, Start, None.

debugLog.title: Debug Logging
debugLog.tooltip: Writes flight details to the mod log, for reporting problems.
